sections.text: The Panama Canal drought caused a logistics disruption across our key shipping routes, adding 10-14 days to transit times during January. Looking ahead, we find it very difficult to predict shipping volumes for the remainder of the year given the macroeconomic uncertainty.
Tom: Can you provide volume guidance for Q2? Raj: Unfortunately, we cannot provide reliable guidance at this time due to the uncertain trade policy environment.
